column2: What interviewers assess at Senior and Staff level
column3: According to the Dropbox Engineering Career Framework, an IC5 Staff Software Engineer sets the multi-year, multi-team technical strategy and delivers it through direct implementation or broad technical leadership. The framework describes the scope as multi-year, multi-team product or platform goals, and open-ended problems where the engineer defines both the what and the how. It describes the collaborative reach as increasingly influencing the roadmaps of other teams, with judgement that favors the priorities of the wider engineering organization over locally optimal outcomes.

According to the Dropbox Engineering Career Framework, an IC5 engineer invests time to coach and mentor teammates, particularly those looking to grow into L4 and L5, and spreads knowledge widely through talks, blog posts or written documentation. The framework also lists helping to break down silos within and across functions and influencing others to reach the best outcome for Dropbox regardless of level or title.
